name: PT MNC Sky Vision Tbk
summary: PT MNC Sky Vision Tbk engages in the retransmission and marketing of television programs through satellites in Indonesia. The company provides family entertainment shows, as well as presents premium and featured channels in high-definition format. It also sells decoders and free to air shows. The company was formerly known as PT Matahari Lintas Cakrawala and changed its name to PT MNC Sky Vision Tbk in December 2006. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia. PT MNC Sky Vision Tbk is a subsidiary of PT MNC Vision Networks Tbk.
